name: brand-foundry
description: Templates your AI agents fill. Branded images, carousels, stat cards, logo reveals and video overlays, rendered on your machine to PNG, MP4 or transparent MOV.

interface.shortDescription: Branded images and video from reusable templates your agent fills
interface.longDescription: Use Brand Foundry to turn a request into an on-brand asset: pick a template, fill in the words and images, and render a PNG, MP4 or transparent MOV locally. When no template fits, the agent writes a new reusable one into your library.
defaultPrompt: Make a 9:16 title card that says "Every frame counts."
Animate my logo with the Goo Spawn reveal as a transparent MOV.
Turn this stat into a stat card for LinkedIn.
